GeneralInformation.StandardReference: Bank of America Reference Guide — Credit and Debit Notification (CAMT.054) — CBPR+ ISO 20022

BusinessContext.Description: Converts SWIFT MT900 (Confirmation of Debit) to ISO 20022 camt.054.001.08 (BankToCustomerDebitCreditNotification). MT900 is sent by a financial institution to confirm to another financial institution that a debit has been made to the sender's account. The camt.054 replaces both MT900 (debit) and MT910 (credit). For MT900: Ntry/CdtDbtInd = DBIT and Ntry/NtryDtls/TxDtls/CdtDbtInd = DBIT. Per SWIFT CBPR+ roadmap: MT900/MT910 migrate to camt.054 by November 2028. Per Bank of America official reference guide: three mandatory new fields are introduced in camt.054 with no MT900 equivalent: NtryRef, Sts, and BkTxCd — all set to fixed values NOTPROVIDED/BOOK/NOTPROVIDED respectively.

UseCases.UseCase: Interbank debit confirmation after funds transfer
Nostro account debit notification to account owner
Settlement confirmation for correspondent banking debits
Exception handling and audit trail for debit transactions
Reconciliation of debit entries in treasury management systems
Confirmation of cover debit for MT202COV payments

BusinessContext.ApplicableDomains: Correspondent Banking, Treasury Operations, Nostro Reconciliation, Interbank Settlement, Cash Management, Payments Hub

TechnicalSpecifications.KeyDifference: MT900 carries only debit notifications. camt.054 handles both debit and credit. CdtDbtInd = DBIT at BOTH entry level AND transaction details level (two paths). Three new mandatory fields introduced in camt.054 not present in MT900: NtryRef (fixed=NOTPROVIDED), Sts/Cd (fixed=BOOK), BkTxCd (fixed=NOTPROVIDED). Field :21: maps to InstrId (not EndToEndId) per official BoA reference guide. Field :32A: maps to FOUR camt.054 paths: Ntry/Amt, Ntry/ValDt/Dt, TxDtls/Amt, and TxDtls/RltdDts/IntrBkSttlmDt.

ComplianceRequirements.Regulation: SWIFT CBPR+ Migration Roadmap — November 2028 for advices
Bank of America Reference Guide — Credit and Debit Notification (CAMT.054)
GDPR — Financial Institution Data Protection (Regulation EU 2016/679)

SourceMessage.Standard: SWIFT ISO 15022 — Category 9 (Cash Management and Customer Status)
SourceMessage.MessagePurpose: Sent by an account servicing institution to the account owner or authorised party to confirm that a debit entry has been posted to the account. Typically generated after processing an outgoing MT103 or MT202. The debit-side counterpart to MT910. Both are replaced by camt.054 in ISO 20022 — distinguished by CdtDbtInd value.

Field.Description: Unique reference assigned by the sender to identify the MT900 message. Per BoA reference guide section 1: maps to both GrpHdr/MsgId and Ntfctn/Id. Must be unique per sender BIC per calendar day. SWIFT Character Set X. Must not start or end with slash. Must not contain double slash.

ValidationRules.Rule: Unique per sender BIC per calendar day
Maximum 16 characters — SWIFT Character Set X
Must not start or end with / (T26 error code)
Must not contain // within reference (T26 error code)

Field.Description: Reference of the original transaction that caused the debit. Per BoA reference guide section 2: maps to Ntfctn/Ntry/NtryDtls/TxDtls/Refs/InstrId (NOT EndToEndId — InstrId is the correct ISO 20022 path for this field). Per BoA example: :21:12314115931671 → InstrId AND EndToEndId both populated. Use NONREF if no related reference is available.

ValidationRules.Rule: Must reference field :20: of the originating transaction
Maximum 16 characters — SWIFT Character Set X
Must not start or end with slash
Use NONREF if no related reference available

Field.Description: Identification of the debited account. Per BoA reference guide section 3: maps to Ntfctn/Acct/Id (IBAN or Othr) AND Ntfctn/Acct/Ccy (currency derived from field :32A:). Option P (25P) maps to Ntfctn/Acct/Ownr/Id/OrgId/AnyBIC — only used when the receiver of the message is not the account owner.

ValidationRules.Rule: Must identify the debited account at the sending institution
Maximum 35 characters
If IBAN format detected, validate modulo-97 checksum per ISO 13616
25P (BIC option) only when receiver is not account owner

Field.Description: Date and time of entry posting with UTC offset. Per BoA reference guide section 4: maps to Ntfctn/Ntry/BookgDt/DtTm. Format: YYMMDD + HHMM + sign + HHMM offset. Only present when booking date differs from value date. If status is BOOK, booking date is mandatory per CBPR+ guidelines. GrpHdr/CreDtTm is always mandatory (system generated at conversion time).

ValidationRules.Rule: Optional — not always present in MT900
If present: date must be valid YYMMDD, time valid HHMM
UTC offset range: -1200 to +1400
When absent and status=BOOK, booking date derived from value date

Field.Description: Value date, currency and amount of the debit entry. Per BoA reference guide section 6: maps to FOUR camt.054 paths: (1) Ntfctn/Ntry/Amt — entry amount with Ccy attribute (2) Ntfctn/Ntry/Amt/@Ccy — currency attribute (3) Ntfctn/Ntry/NtryDtls/TxDtls/Amt — transaction amount (same value) (4) Ntfctn/Ntry/NtryDtls/TxDtls/RltdDts/IntrBkSttlmDt — interbank settlement date Also used to derive: Ntfctn/Ntry/ValDt/Dt (value date) and Ntfctn/Acct/Ccy. Amount precision: FractionDigits=5, TotalDigits=18 per ISO 20022 schema. SWIFT convention: comma decimal separator → ISO 20022: dot decimal separator.

Component.name: Date
Component.description: Value date YYMMDD — effective date of debit

Component.name: Amount
Component.description: Debit amount — comma decimal separator (SWIFT convention)

ValidationRules.Rule: Date must be valid YYMMDD calendar date
Currency must be valid ISO 4217 alpha-3 code
Amount must be positive — sign conveyed by CdtDbtInd = DBIT
Decimal separator must be comma in MT900 (converted to dot in camt.054)
Amount fraction digits: up to 5 decimal places per ISO 20022 schema
Amount total digits: up to 18 per ISO 20022 schema

Field.Description: BIC of the financial institution that originated the transaction causing this debit. Per BoA reference guide section 8: maps to Ntfctn/Ntry/NtryDtls/TxDtls/RltdAgts/DbtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI. Optional — not always present in MT900.

ValidationRules.Rule: Valid BIC format (8 or 11 chars) if present
BIC must exist in SWIFT BIC Directory
Subject to institutional sanctions screening

Field.Description: Additional information from sender to receiver. Per BoA reference guide section 10: maps to Ntfctn/Ntry/NtryDtls/TxDtls/AddtlTxInf (Max500Text). May contain structured codes (/EREF/, /REMI/, etc.) or free text. Per BoA example: :72:/SETTIME/12595235 → AddtlTxInf = "/SETTIME/12595235" Full content preserved without parsing into separate elements.

ValidationRules.Rule: Optional — not always present
Maximum 6 lines of 35 characters (210 total)
Content preserved as-is in AddtlTxInf (Max500Text)
AML screening per bank policy

TargetMessage.MT900_Specific_Note: MT900-derived camt.054 always has: - Ntry/CdtDbtInd = DBIT - Ntry/NtryDtls/TxDtls/CdtDbtInd = DBIT (BOTH levels mandatory) - Ntry/NtryRef = "NOTPROVIDED" (mandatory new field, fixed value) - Ntry/Sts/Cd = BOOK (mandatory new field, fixed value) - Ntry/BkTxCd/Prtry/Cd = "NOTPROVIDED" (mandatory new field, fixed value) - Ntry/BkTxCd/Prtry/Issr = "NOTPROVIDED" (mandatory new field, fixed value)

Field.Description: Point-to-point reference for the camt.054 message. Per BoA guide section 1: derived from MT900 field :20:. The account servicing institution must ensure uniqueness per account owner.
Date and time of camt.054 message creation. Per BoA guide format key table: always mandatory in camt.054 GrpHdr. No equivalent in MT900 — system generated at conversion time in UTC.
Unique notification identifier. Per BoA guide section 1: also mapped from MT900 field :20:. Set equal to GrpHdr/MsgId for MT900 single-notification messages.
Debited account identification. Per BoA guide section 3: IBAN or Othr/Id from MT900 field :25:. If IBAN detected and valid → Acct/Id/IBAN. Otherwise → Acct/Id/Othr/Id.
Currency of the debited account. Per BoA guide section 3: derived from currency component of MT900 field :32A:. New element in camt.054 with no direct MT900 account-level equivalent.
Mandatory new field in camt.054 with no MT900 equivalent. Per BoA guide format key table row 12: fixed value = "NOTPROVIDED". Always set to "NOTPROVIDED" for MT900-derived messages.

Absolute debit amount with ISO 4217 currency as Ccy attribute. Per BoA guide section 6: converted from MT900 field :32A: amount component. SWIFT comma decimal → ISO dot decimal. Amount always positive. Fraction digits: 5, Total digits: 18 per ISO 20022 schema.

Credit/debit indicator at entry level. Per BoA guide section 5: derived from message type in block2. MT900 → DBIT. MT910 → CRDT. Also set at TxDtls level (FIELD_13) — BOTH levels are mandatory per BoA guide.
Mandatory new field in camt.054 with no MT900 equivalent. Per BoA guide format key table row 13: fixed value = BOOK. MT900 confirms a completed booked debit — always BOOK.

Date and time of entry booking. Per BoA guide section 4: mapped from MT900 field :13D: when present. Per CBPR+ guidelines: if status=BOOK and :13D: absent, derive from value date. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM (with UTC offset per :13D: sign/offset).
Value date of the debit entry. Per BoA guide section 6: converted from date component of MT900 field :32A:. YYMMDD → YYYY-MM-DD using CENTURY_CUTOFF_YEAR.
Mandatory new field in camt.054 with no MT900 equivalent. Per BoA guide format key table row 14: fixed value = "NOTPROVIDED". Also requires BkTxCd/Prtry/Issr = "NOTPROVIDED".

Instruction identification for the transaction. Per BoA guide section 2: mapped from MT900 field :21: (Related Reference). Maps to InstrId (NOT EndToEndId — InstrId is the correct path per BoA standard). Also set as EndToEndId per BoA example XML showing both elements populated.
Transaction-level amount — same value as Ntry/Amt. Per BoA guide section 6: :32A: maps to BOTH Ntry/Amt AND TxDtls/Amt. Both must be populated with the same amount and currency.

Credit/debit indicator at transaction details level. Per BoA guide section 5: CdtDbtInd appears at BOTH Ntry level AND TxDtls level. Both must be set to DBIT for MT900-derived messages. Both must be set to CRDT for MT910-derived messages.

Interbank settlement date — date funds were settled between institutions. Per BoA guide section 6: :32A: date also maps to TxDtls/RltdDts/IntrBkSttlmDt. Same value as Ntry/ValDt/Dt — the :32A: date component populates both paths.

BIC of the ordering institution. Per BoA guide section 8: mapped from MT900 field :52A:. Identifies the financial institution that originated the debit transaction. Optional — only present when :52A: is provided in MT900.

Additional transaction information preserving full :72: content. Per BoA guide section 10: :72: maps to AddtlTxInf (Max500Text). Per BoA example: :72:/SETTIME/12595235 → AddtlTxInf = "/SETTIME/12595235" Content preserved as-is — no parsing into sub-elements for MT900.

Condition.Expression: NOT starts_with(field_20, "/") AND NOT ends_with(field_20, "/") AND NOT contains(field_20, "//")
Condition.ElseAction: REJECT "E003: Field :20: violates SWIFT slash rule T26"

Condition.Action: PROCEED — field :20: (16 chars max) always fits in Max35Text
Condition.ElseAction: N/A — impossible given condition 2 already enforces 16 chars max

General.ImpactIfFails: Notification unidentifiable. Duplicate detection impossible. Schema validation fails — MsgId and Ntfctn/Id are mandatory in camt.054.
General.BusinessRationale: Field :20: populates two camt.054 elements simultaneously: GrpHdr/MsgId (message-level identifier) and Ntfctn/Id (notification-level identifier). Per BoA guide: both are derived from the same MT900 reference value. The account servicing institution must ensure uniqueness per account owner for a pre-agreed period.
General.AuditRequirement: All notifications logged with field :20: reference, sender BIC, and conversion timestamp for AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years.
General.ComplianceRequirement: MsgId and Ntfctn/Id mandatory per camt.054 schema. Global uniqueness per CBPR+ guidelines.
General.DataPrivacy: Message ID is operational metadata. No customer PII.
General.MigrationNote: MT900 field :20: maximum 16 characters fits within camt.054 Max35Text (35 chars). No truncation needed. Both MsgId and Ntfctn/Id receive the same value per BoA reference guide — unlike MT950 where MsgId gets a timestamp suffix.
General.CachingStrategy: Processed references cached in Redis for DUPLICATE_DETECTION_WINDOW_HOURS for duplicate detection.

General.ImpactIfFails: Schema validation failure — GrpHdr/CreDtTm mandatory in camt.054.
General.BusinessRationale: GrpHdr/CreDtTm is a mandatory camt.054 header field. No MT900 equivalent. Generated at conversion time in UTC per CBPR+ requirement.
General.AuditRequirement: Conversion timestamp logged for SLA measurement.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Mandatory per camt.054 schema. UTC per CBPR+.
General.MigrationNote: MT900 has no creation timestamp. camt.054 requires it. Generated fresh at conversion time — never cached.

MappingFormula.Expression: if(isIBAN(MT.F25)) Ntfctn.Acct.Id.IBAN = MT.F25; else Ntfctn.Acct.Id.Othr.Id = MT.F25

Condition.ElseAction: REJECT SECURITY "SEC001: Account not authorized for recipient"
OMIT Acct/Ccy — optional field, do not reject

General.ImpactIfFails: Notification for wrong account — reconciliation failure and unauthorized financial data disclosure. Security incident.
General.BusinessRationale: Account identification is the primary key linking notification to the correct nostro ledger. Currency is derived from :32A: per BoA guide — no separate currency field in MT900. Both IBAN and proprietary formats supported.
General.PerformanceImpact: LOW — IBAN regex + modulo-97 + authorization lookup (~6ms)
General.AuditRequirement: Account ID and authorization result logged per notification. Retention: AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Account authorization per banking secrecy laws and GDPR Article 5. IBAN validation per ISO 13616.
General.DataPrivacy: Account number is financial confidential data. AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3+ in transit.
General.MigrationNote: MT900 field :25: max 35 chars → camt.054 IBAN (34 chars max) or Othr/Id (35 chars max). Account currency derived from :32A: currency component — new camt.054 Acct/Ccy element with no direct MT900 equivalent at account level.
General.CachingStrategy: Authorization cached per session. Invalidated on account change.

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: Ntry.Amt = decimal(MT.F32A.amount.replace(",",".")) Ntry.CdtDbtInd = "DBIT" Ntry.ValDt.Dt = expandCentury(MT.F32A.date, "yyMMdd", CENTURY_CUTOFF_YEAR) TxDtls.Amt = decimal(MT.F32A.amount.replace(",",".")) TxDtls.CdtDbtInd = "DBIT" TxDtls.RltdDts.IntrBkSttlmDt = expandCentury(MT.F32A.date, "yyMMdd", CENTURY_CUTOFF_YEAR)

Condition.ElseAction: ALERT treasury AND PROCEED — warning not rejection

Condition.Action: SET Ntry/ValDt/Dt = iso_date AND TxDtls/RltdDts/IntrBkSttlmDt = iso_date (same value)
SET Ntry/Amt = amount AND TxDtls/Amt = amount (same value, both mandatory)

General.ImpactIfFails: Complete notification failure — amount and value date are the core financial data. All six target paths must be populated correctly or camt.054 schema validation fails.
General.BusinessRationale: Field :32A: is the most data-rich single field in MT900 — it populates 6 distinct camt.054 paths simultaneously per BoA reference guide: (1+2) Ntry/Amt + Ccy — entry-level amount for statement matching (3) Ntry/ValDt/Dt — value date for interest calculation (4+5) TxDtls/Amt + Ccy — transaction-level amount for payment chain (6) TxDtls/RltdDts/IntrBkSttlmDt — interbank settlement date for RTGS reporting CdtDbtInd set at BOTH Ntry and TxDtls levels per BoA guide section 5. Amount precision: FractionDigits=5, TotalDigits=18 per ISO 20022 schema.
General.AuditRequirement: Amount, currency, date, and both CdtDbtInd values logged per notification. Large debit alerts logged separately. Retention: AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Accurate debit reporting for Basel III LCR (BCBS 248). CdtDbtInd correctness critical — incorrect direction causes wrong-direction posting with regulatory implications. IntrBkSttlmDt required for RTGS settlement confirmation reporting.
General.DataPrivacy: Transaction amounts are financial confidential data. Restricted to authorized treasury systems.
General.MigrationNote: CRITICAL CORRECTIONS vs previous version: (1) DECIMAL: SWIFT comma (25000,50) → ISO dot (25000.50) — mandatory (2) DATE: SWIFT YYMMDD → ISO YYYY-MM-DD using century cutoff (3) DUAL CdtDbtInd: must be set at BOTH Ntry/CdtDbtInd AND TxDtls/CdtDbtInd (4) DUAL AMOUNT: must populate BOTH Ntry/Amt AND TxDtls/Amt (5) DUAL DATE: ValDt/Dt AND IntrBkSttlmDt both receive the :32A: date (6) PRECISION: FractionDigits=5, TotalDigits=18 (not 2 decimal places)
General.CachingStrategy: No caching — parsed fresh from each MT900.

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: ref = (MT.F21 == "NONREF") ? "NOTPROVIDED" : MT.F21.trim() Refs.InstrId = ref Refs.EndToEndId = ref

Condition.Action: SET InstrId = value AND EndToEndId = value (both per BoA example XML)

General.ImpactIfFails: Automated reconciliation impossible — cannot match debit notification to original payment. Manual intervention required.
General.BusinessRationale: Per BoA guide section 2: field :21: maps to InstrId (not EndToEndId as erroneously mapped in earlier version). Per BoA example XML: both InstrId AND EndToEndId are populated with the same value from field :21:. This dual population ensures compatibility with receivers that use either reference element for reconciliation.
General.AuditRequirement: Related reference logged per notification for transaction lifecycle audit trail.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Transaction traceability per FATF Travel Rule and correspondent banking AML obligations.
General.DataPrivacy: Payment reference is operational data — not personal data per GDPR.
General.MigrationNote: CORRECTION from earlier version: :21: maps to InstrId (not EndToEndId alone). Per BoA official guide section 2 XPath: Refs/InstrId. Per BoA example XML: both InstrId and EndToEndId populated with same value. NONREF → NOTPROVIDED per ISO 20022 convention.

Condition.Action: SET all three fixed-value mandatory new fields for every MT900-derived camt.054

General.ImpactIfFails: camt.054 schema validation failure — NtryRef, Sts, and BkTxCd are mandatory elements. Receiving systems that validate against camt.054 XSD will reject the message entirely.
General.BusinessRationale: Three new mandatory fields in camt.054 with no MT900 equivalent. Per BoA reference guide format key table rows 12, 13, 14: Row 12: NtryRef = "NOTPROVIDED" (mandatory, fixed) Row 13: Sts/Cd = BOOK (mandatory, fixed — MT900 confirms booked entries only) Row 14: BkTxCd = "NOTPROVIDED" (mandatory, fixed — no SWIFT transaction code in MT900) These three fields are schema-required in camt.054 and must always be populated. Without them, the generated XML will fail XSD validation at receiving institutions.
General.AuditRequirement: Fixed values logged as part of standard camt.054 generation audit.
General.ComplianceRequirement: camt.054.001.08 XSD requires these three elements. CBPR+ mandates schema-valid messages. Receiving institutions reject schema-invalid messages per SWIFT network rules.
General.MigrationNote: NEW in corrected version — these fields were missing from the previous mapping. NtryRef: identifies the entry in the account servicing institution's books — "NOTPROVIDED" used when not available from MT900 source. Sts/Cd = BOOK: confirmed from MT900 semantics — this message type only sent after booking is complete. BkTxCd: identifies the type of transaction per ISO 20022 external code set — "NOTPROVIDED" used when MT900 carries no transaction type code. Per BoA example XML: BkTxCd uses Prtry (proprietary) sub-element with both Cd and Issr = "NOTPROVIDED".

General.ImpactIfFails: Ordering institution missing from camt.054 — payment chain incomplete but notification still delivered.
General.BusinessRationale: Per BoA guide section 8: :52A: maps to DbtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI. Optional — present only when included in MT900. Enables full payment chain traceability.
General.AuditRequirement: Ordering institution BIC logged when present.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Institutional sanctions screening if BIC present. FATF correspondent banking requirements.
General.DataPrivacy: BIC is public identifier. No PII.
General.MigrationNote: :52A: optional in MT900. When present: maps to DbtrAgt BICFI via extractBIC() helper (strips optional /account prefix line). Option D (name/address) not supported in this mapping — option A (BIC) is standard for interbank MT900.

General.ImpactIfFails: Loss of supplemental information — notification still delivered. Supplemental reconciliation data unavailable to receiver.
General.BusinessRationale: Per BoA guide section 10: :72: maps directly to AddtlTxInf (Max500Text). Content preserved as-is per BoA example: :72:/SETTIME/12595235 → AddtlTxInf = "/SETTIME/12595235". No parsing into sub-elements — full content preservation is the standard per BoA guide.
General.PerformanceImpact: NEGLIGIBLE — direct string copy with length check
General.AuditRequirement: Full :72: content preserved in camt.054 for audit completeness.
General.ComplianceRequirement: AML content screening per bank policy. Max500Text constraint per camt.054 schema — MT900 :72: max 210 chars always fits.
General.DataPrivacy: May contain payment narrative with PII references. Apply same protections as payment data.
General.MigrationNote: CORRECTION: previous version mapped :72: to RmtInf/Ustrd. Correct per BoA guide: AddtlTxInf (Max500Text). MT900 :72: max 210 chars — always within 500 char limit. No structured code parsing — full content goes to AddtlTxInf as-is.

General.ImpactIfFails: Booking timestamp absent from camt.054. Optional field — notification still valid. Impact: intraday liquidity monitoring less precise.
General.BusinessRationale: Per BoA guide section 4: :13D: maps to BookgDt/DtTm. Per CBPR+ guidelines: if status=BOOK and :13D: absent, booking date may be derived from value date. Optional in MT900 — not all sending institutions include it.
General.AuditRequirement: Booking timestamp logged when present for precise timing audit.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Per BoA guide: if status is BOOK, booking date is mandatory when available. When :13D: absent, BookgDt may be omitted or set equal to ValDt.
General.MigrationNote: parseDateTimeOffset() handles :13D: format: YYMMDD + HHMM + sign + HHMM → ISO: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS±HH:MM. Per BoA example: :13D:1302091701-0600 → 2013-02-09T17:00:00+02:00 (note offset sign inversion in example). Applies CENTURY_CUTOFF_YEAR for date conversion.
